features: High-output monocrystalline architecture for utility projects
Half-cell layout helps reduce resistive loss in large arrays
Repeatable documentation pack for EPC and procurement review

translations.name: Skyworth Mono 550W PV Module
translations.shortDescription: High-output monocrystalline module for EPCs and utility-scale developers.
translations.description: A bankable 550W module engineered for repeatable field performance, strict QA control, and predictable BOS planning. The half-cell design supports lower resistive loss and better shade tolerance across large ground-mount projects.
translations.metaDescription: Technical specs, certifications, datasheet, and RFQ flow for Skyworth 550W monocrystalline PV modules.

translations.name: Modul PV Skyworth Mono 550W
translations.shortDescription: Modul monokristalin berdaya tinggi untuk EPC dan proyek utility-scale.
translations.description: Modul 550W yang dirancang untuk performa lapangan stabil, kontrol kualitas ketat, dan perencanaan BOS yang mudah diprediksi. Desain half-cell membantu mengurangi rugi resistif dan meningkatkan toleransi bayangan.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi teknis, sertifikasi, datasheet, dan RFQ untuk modul PV monokristalin Skyworth 550W.

features: Compact format for constrained rooftop layouts
Balanced handling weight for faster installer movement
Strong fit for distributed commercial generation projects

translations.name: Skyworth Rooftop 430W PV Module
translations.shortDescription: Compact high-efficiency module for commercial rooftops and distributed generation.
translations.description: Optimized for commercial rooftop constraints with balanced power density, handling weight, and certification coverage for repeatable multi-site rollouts.
translations.metaDescription: Compact 430W PV module for commercial rooftop procurement and RFQ workflows.

translations.name: Modul PV Skyworth Rooftop 430W
translations.shortDescription: Modul efisiensi tinggi yang ringkas untuk rooftop komersial dan distributed generation.
translations.description: Dioptimalkan untuk batasan rooftop komersial dengan kepadatan daya, bobot pemasangan, dan cakupan sertifikasi yang seimbang untuk rollout banyak lokasi.
translations.metaDescription: Modul PV 430W ringkas untuk procurement rooftop komersial dan alur RFQ.

features: Bifacial energy capture for higher lifetime yield
N-type TOPCon cell platform with low annual degradation
Designed for ground-mount proposals that prioritize performance

translations.name: Skyworth Bifacial 600W TOPCon Module
translations.shortDescription: N-type bifacial module for high-yield ground-mount projects.
translations.description: Designed for projects where lifetime yield matters, this TOPCon bifacial module combines higher rear-side energy capture with low annual degradation.
translations.metaDescription: 600W bifacial TOPCon module specs, certifications, datasheet download, and RFQ.

translations.name: Modul TOPCon Bifacial Skyworth 600W
translations.shortDescription: Modul bifacial N-type untuk proyek ground-mount dengan yield tinggi.
translations.description: Dirancang untuk proyek yang menekankan yield sepanjang umur aset, modul bifacial TOPCon ini menggabungkan tangkapan energi sisi belakang dengan degradasi tahunan rendah.
translations.metaDescription: Spesifikasi modul TOPCon bifacial 600W, sertifikasi, unduh datasheet, dan RFQ.
